findings.body:
Gain 5, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Not done. Case: normal use - a new conversation whose first turn is still running startup or prompt hooks. New evidence beyond the coordinator note: [pinned Codex's turn-input implementation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openai/codex/rust-v0.159.2/codex-rs/core/src/session/turn_input.rs) explicitly returns before rollout persistence. Consequently, returning from thread.turn() does not establish the prerequisite for this metadata update. It can still fail with 'no rollout found', print project_skipped, and never assign the project after persistence finishes because assignment is attempted only once. The new proof misses this ordering: tests/test_codex_resume.py:128–141 saves the stub's turn before acknowledging turn/start. Defer assignment until persistence is established, and make the command test cover acknowledgement before rollout creation.
